saw_lines: Perfume is chosen by how it smells on the skin, and most buyers return to the same bottle for years.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides to stop scrolling or keep going.
Your 28 copy ads carry no proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust. Collect one real number, like a review count, and open three new ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 20 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 28 copy ads carry a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust. That costs you the click. Collect one real number, like a review count, and open three new ads with it.
0 of 28 copy ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Build three new ads that open with one first order offer or a bundle, so the reason to buy comes before the scroll.

Your 28 copy ads open with 12 different stories, and the biggest opens only 6, so no single pitch sticks. Build the next batch only from your two strongest openers, the Titanium story and the Georgina Rodríguez ambassador line.

17 ads have run 60+ days, so the pitch holds up. Without variations, viewers who already saw it keep scrolling past. Build three more versions of the Anthony Joshua Titanium video, each with a new first line.
